items.title: FPIs withdraw Rs 48,056 cr from equities in Oct so far amid elevated crude oil prices
items.description: Foreign investors withdrew significant funds from Indian equities in October amid concerns over inflation and crude oil prices. Despite this, there were signs of moderation in selling with two days of net buying. The overall FPI outflows from equities in 2026 have reached notable levels compared to previous years. Market participants are closely monitoring upcoming macroeconomic developments including US GDP data.

items.title: Dividends & stock splits: L&T Tech, Shriram Finance among 24 stocks turning ex-record date this week. Do you own?
items.description: As many as 24 companies will turn ex-record date for dividends, stock splits and rights issues during the week starting October 26. Key names include Shriram Finance, CRISIL, Cyient, Chennai Petroleum and L&T Technology Services.

items.title: Sebi to revamp short-selling, securities lending rules
items.description: Sebi is reviewing short-selling and securities lending rules to improve liquidity and price discovery. The regulator is also planning reforms in clearing, broker compliance, custodial services and corporate bond market-making to deepen capital markets and reduce compliance costs.

items.title: Nifty bears tighten grip as crude, geopolitical risks, FII outflows mount: 5 factors to decide D-Street’s fate next week
items.description: Indian stock markets faced a setback as crude oil prices soared, triggered by increasing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. Despite some defensive buying from domestic institutions, foreign investors pulled back. The forthcoming US Federal Reserve meeting is poised to impact global market moods. Investors will be keenly watching industrial production metrics and second-quarter earnings for insights on corporate health, as macroeconomic stability remains crucial for market trends.

items.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
items.description: Indian equities fell over 2% last week as rising crude oil prices, FII outflows and geopolitical tensions weighed on sentiment. Broader markets underperformed, while global indices also declined and market breadth strongly favoured bears.

items.title: Peter Lynch on stock picking: 'You shouldn't own a stock if you can't…'
items.description: Peter Lynch’s investing advice centres on understanding a company before buying its stock. The legendary Fidelity Magellan Fund manager stresses researching business fundamentals, growth prospects and financials rather than investing based on popularity or hearsay.

items.title: 11 Penny stocks surged up to 180% in 3 months. Do you own any?
items.description: Over the last three months, eight penny stocks have delivered price returns ranging from 35% to 180%. These stocks were identified using a defined set of filters: a market capitalisation below Rs 1,000 crore, a share price under Rs 20, and a minimum latest trading volume of 5 lakh shares. The screening criteria were to identify low-priced, actively traded microcap stocks that had delivered strong upward price momentum. (Data Source: ACE Equity)

items.title: Mcap of 8 of top-10 firms erodes by Rs 1.55 lakh cr; HDFC Bank, Bajaj Fin biggest laggards
items.description: Recently, the market witnessed a downturn, with eight of the leading firms in India suffering major valuation losses. The declines of HDFC Bank and Bajaj Finance were particularly striking. The BSE Sensex plummeted by 1,605.44 points, indicating a bearish atmosphere across equities. While Tata Consultancy Services and Larsen & Toubro showed some gains, the overall trend remained negative.

items.title: F&O Talk: Nifty plunged 2% this week. Are charts indicating a deeper sell-off?
items.description: SBI Securities’ Sudeep Shah expects continued weakness in Indian equities as FII positioning, rising volatility and technical indicators point to further pressure. He identifies key Nifty support and resistance levels and flags IT as a relatively stronger sector.

items.title: Warren Buffett’s 6 golden rules for investors after retirement
items.description: Warren Buffett’s retirement advice focuses on low-cost index investing, paying off high-interest debt, maintaining cash reserves, staying within one’s circle of competence and living frugally. His long-standing principles offer lessons on building wealth, managing risk and making sound financial decisions.

items.description: Our technical analysts identify select stocks every trading day that may gain momentum even in volatile markets. Here are the technical calls for today.
